decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork system closely tied to the firm's core engineering and modular formwork knowledge, it remains easy to improve and integrate into customer projects, so management would continue it.

This automated flow-control product builds on the firm's automation capabilities and in-house R&D, and although it appears more niche than the core formwork lines, it still fits the firm's learning base well enough to retain and refine.

Magnetic formwork strips are highly complementary to the firm's established systems and benefit from strong related knowledge and customer feedback loops, making continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal.

Because this magnetic formwork component is close to the firm's existing product architecture and absorptive capacity, management would likely keep it as part of the broader modular offering rather than release its resources.
